name: Barber Packaging Company
old_description: Family-owned and operated since 1989, we believe in building true partnerships.
about:
Barber Packaging Company was founded in 1989 in Bangor, Michigan, as a family-owned and operated business. The company began with a focus on building long-term partnerships through engineered packaging solutions.

The company provides a full-service approach to protective packaging, covering design and engineering using CAD technology, rapid prototyping, manufacturing, validation and testing, and program management. Its product range includes returnable packaging made from steel, wood, plastics, textiles, and foam; expendable packaging for export and retail; work-in-process material handling systems; and service/backup packaging. Manufacturing capabilities include CNC abrasive wire, CNC oscillating and tangential cutting, and automated assembly.

Barber serves a variety of industries that require protective packaging, though specific sectors are not listed publicly. Customers include OEMs and assembly plants needing intra-plant material handling, export shipping solutions, and custom protective packaging for product protection.

The company differentiates itself through "The Barber Way," a relationship-based philosophy emphasizing simple coordination, faster turnaround, cost savings, and single-source solutions. Its in-house design team and accredited lab partnerships enable quick iteration and compliance testing, while program management ensures projects stay on schedule and budget.
